verdicts.reason: A shrinks the SOLSTICE logo until the wordmark is barely readable, drops the headline below the glow, and pushes the CTA to the very bottom, so the two are disconnected and the top half is a large dead area; a bokeh dot also collides with 'Light'. B keeps the logo at a readable size, groups the headline and CTA as one centred block over the glow, and keeps the original's hierarchy. Its only issues are minor: the block sits slightly low and bokeh dots brush the edges of the headline and CTA.
